[[File:Bridgeworld.jpg|thumb|250px|[[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidian]] bridge cities hanging between immense rock arches.]]
'''Bridge cities''' were huge structures hanging between massive rock arches on [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]]. They were covered in huge, lavish [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] palaces and factories.

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Neimoidians stationed large armies of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] and [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|AATs]] on these [[City/Legends|cities]] to protect their valuables in case of a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] attack.

At the [[Battle of Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Battle of Cato Neimoidia]], one such bridge city received mild damage when [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon's]] [[Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|starfighter]] crashed into it, having been shot down by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Jai'galaar (clone)|Jag]] in his [[Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter/Legends|ARC-170 starfighter]] in compliance with [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]]. The crash caused casualties at the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] staging area there.
